name: DBARF
aliases: DBARF (Deep Bundle-Adjusting Generalizable Neural Radiance Fields)
Deep Bundle-Adjusting Generalizable Neural Radiance Fields
definition: A method to jointly optimize camera poses with Generalizable Neural Radiance Fields (GeNeRFs) by implicitly minimizing feature consistency errors via a recurrent neural network, overcoming gradient issues in direct optimization.
summary: DBARF jointly optimizes camera poses with Generalizable Neural Radiance Fields using a recurrent network to minimize feature consistency errors, avoiding the coarse-to-fine training required by BARF.
